words.definition: something full of special and exciting quality
words.example: The lights and music created a magical atmosphere at the festival.
words.cloze: The lights and music created a ________ atmosphere at the festival.

words.definition: during the whole period of time, or, in every part of a place
words.example: The film was exciting throughout, from the first scene to the last.
words.cloze: The film was exciting ________, from the first scene to the last.

words.definition: something that you think of usual rather than special
words.example: Breakfast is included in the standard room price.
words.cloze: Breakfast is included in the ________ room price.

words.definition: a set of rooms, in a hotel, that are connected

words.cloze: The hotel ________ has a bedroom, a living room and two bathrooms.

words.definition: give someone information

words.cloze: Please ________ the office if your phone number changes.

words.definition: what you wear on your feet: shoes, boots, slippers, sandals, trainers, etc.

words.definition: become available (a job, an opportunity, an idea, etc.)

words.cloze: A chance to work abroad may ________ next year.

words.definition: (work, activities, etc.) that you do for only a part of the day or week
words.example: She works part-time at a café for three afternoons a week.

words.definition: to feel mental or physical pain

words.cloze: People with this illness may ________ severe pain in their joints.

words.definition: the part of a cooker with a door used to cook food in

words.definition: a place where bread, cakes etc. are made or sold

words.cloze: Her first ________ to climb the wall was unsuccessful, but she tried again.

words.definition: an open container with a handle used for carrying liquids mostly

words.definition: to become less active and effective

words.definition: relating to the central government of a country, and not to the government of a region (in countries such as the USA, Germany, Russia, etc.)

words.cloze: The ________ government makes decisions that affect the whole country.

words.definition: a system that allows you to use the internet to transfer money from a bank account

words.cloze: I use ________ to transfer money without visiting a bank.

words.definition: using a telephone line to slowly connect computers or smartphones with internet services (used in the past, before broadband)
words.example: Our old dial-up connection used a telephone line to access the internet.
words.cloze: Our old ________ connection used a telephone line to access the internet.

words.definition: not simple, something with many different parts that make it difficult to understand

words.cloze: The instructions were so ________ that I had to read them three times.

words.definition: a device that is sent into space to travel around the earth in order to collect information

words.definition: a machine invented to do a particular thing

words.cloze: This small ________ measures your heart rate while you exercise.

words.definition: relating with the emotions, something that makes you feel sad, happy, etc.

words.cloze: The study looked at the ________ side of learning, including students' feelings.

words.definition: a loud noise or flashing light that warns you of danger

words.definition: organisations that deal with urgent problems and accidents (police, fire service, ambulances, etc.)

words.definition: a car, bus, lorry, etc., with wheels and an engine that you travel in or on
